proc_p: Loft wardrobes take four to six weeks to make once you approve the design.
steps: We measure the pitch of your ceiling and the height at every point along the wall.
You see the wardrobe following your roofline in 3D, with a quote that lists every part.
Each carcass and door is cut to the angle of your ceiling in our workshop.
We fit it tight to the slope so there are no gaps, backed by our 12-month guarantee.
